prerequisites: Knowledge of electromagnetic theory with particular reference to the wave propagation equation.
Knowledge of all subjects treated in Physics II is particularly recommended

learning_outcomes.text: Provide the basic information regarding Photonics.
Review relevant topics in electromagnetic theory useful for understanding the operation of components and devices in the field of frequencies traceable to photonic techniques.
Give students the necessary tools and information to apply to basic component design and experimentation in photonics.
Develop in students the ability to independently choose the most direct solving strategy for exercises to obtain practical design tools.
Independently conduct experiments using laser sources.

syllabus_topics: Principle of operation of light sources
Principle of operation of laser sources
Basic properties of Gaussian beams as a model for the beam emitted by lasers
Main components that can be used to manipulate laser beams
Modulators based on electro-optic and acousto-optic effects
Principles of integrated photonics and fiber optics
assessment_rules: The assessment consists of a written test followed by an oral exam. The written test lasts 2 hours and assesses the ability to use acquired information for quantitative design. The oral exam lasts about 25 minutes and tests knowledge of physical principles and relevant physical phenomena for photonic frequencies. The grading is a final grade.
bibliography: V. Degiorgio, I. Photonics. Springer. The course program is fully covered by the content of this text
B.E.A. Saleh, M.C. Teich. Fundamentals of Photonics. Mc Graw-Hill. This text is very wide and rich. It is recommended for those who want to deepen some of the course topics.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica E Informatica (Electronic And Computer Engineering), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
